# Impression Beauty Hair Salon

> Hair salon based in Bloomington, Indiana. Layers, perms, color and keratin from stylists who know soft, fine and straight hair, a short walk from the IU campus. English and Chinese spoken.

- Phone: (812) 340-1677
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Martinsville, Nashville, Columbus
- Google rating: 4.9 from 243 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/indiana/impression-beauty-hair-salon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/indiana/impression-beauty-hair-salon/book.html

## Services
- Women's cuts & layers: Soft, airy layers and precise shapes that work with fine, straight hair, not against it.
- Men's cuts & fades: Clean fades, two-block cuts and textured tops, including cuts that pair with a perm.
- Perms & waves: Soft waves to full curls, chosen for your hair type. Ask why a look will or won't work, and they'll tell you.
- Keratin & sleek styling: Smoother, straighter, shinier hair that still looks healthy and keeps its length.
- Color & bleaching: Rich brunettes, reds, ash tones and lightening, done carefully on dark hair.
- Lashes, brows & facials: Lash extensions, facials and semi-permanent makeup in a quiet room off the salon floor.

## About
Impression 印象 Beauty Hair Salon is a small, warm studio at 512 W 4th St in downtown Bloomington, full of trailing plants, walnut panels and round mirrors. English and Chinese are both spoken here. It has become the place to go for Asian hair in Indiana. Reviewers say Amy and Louis evaluate your hair first, explain honestly when a reference photo won't suit it, and then find a cut or perm that will. Clients come from campus and from across town for layers that hold, perms that look natural and a calm afternoon in the chair. Sometimes there are snacks while the perm sets. Beyond hair, there is a quiet room for lash extensions, facials and semi-permanent brows and eyeliner.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you specialize in Asian hair?
  A: Yes. Reviewers call it a rare find in Indiana for Asian hair: soft, fine and straight hair, layered cuts and perms.
- Q: Can I bring a reference photo?
  A: Please do. If the look won't suit your hair, Amy and Louis will explain why and help you find one that will.
- Q: How much is a haircut?
  A: Men's cuts start at $45 and women's cuts at $55, depending on length and thickness. The full price list is on the Services page.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through our booking page, where you pick the service and the time, or call (812) 340-1677. You can cancel or reschedule up to 24 hours before your appointment.
- Q: Do you do lashes and brows?
  A: Yes: eyelash extensions, facials, and semi-permanent makeup such as misty powder brows, 3D brows, eyeliner and lash line tattoo.
- Q: Do you speak Chinese?
  A: Yes, both English and Chinese are spoken. 我们讲中文.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 11 am to 7 pm. Closed Sunday.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 512 W 4th St, Bloomington, IN 47404, downtown and a short walk from the IU campus.
